items.known: CKV_AWS_39 Ensure Amazon EKS public endpoint disabled (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS API server public endpoint not explicitly disabled
items.remediation: Add 'endpoint_public_access = false' inside the vpc_config block. If public access is required, restrict it using 'public_access_cidrs' to known IP ranges rather than leaving it open to 0.0.0.0/0.

items.known: CKV_AWS_37 Ensure Amazon EKS control plane logging is enabled for all log types (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS control plane logging not enabled
items.remediation: Add an 'enabled_cluster_log_types' attribute to the aws_eks_cluster resource, e.g.: enabled_cluster_log_types = ["api", "audit", "authenticator", "controllerManager", "scheduler"]

items.known: CKV_AWS_58 Ensure EKS Cluster has Secrets Encryption Enabled (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS secrets not encrypted with KMS
items.remediation: Add an encryption_config block to the aws_eks_cluster resource specifying a KMS key ARN for secrets: encryption_config { provider { key_arn = aws_kms_key.eks.arn } resources = ["secrets"] }

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet1)
items.remediation: Set 'map_public_ip_on_launch = false' in the aws_subnet.eks_subnet1 resource. Worker nodes should reside in private subnets and access the internet via a NAT gateway if needed.

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet2)
items.remediation: Set 'map_public_ip_on_launch = false' in the aws_subnet.eks_subnet2 resource. Worker nodes should reside in private subnets and access the internet via a NAT gateway if needed.

items.known: CKV2_AWS_11 Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs (resource aws_vpc.eks_vpc)
items.remediation: Create an aws_flow_log resource associated with the VPC: resource "aws_flow_log" "eks_vpc" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.eks_vpc.id traffic_type = "ALL" iam_role_arn = aws_iam_role.flow_log_role.arn log_destination = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.flow_log.arn }

scores.reason: Setting endpoint_public_access = false in vpc_config is the standard fix; the public_access_cidrs note is an additional valid option.
enabled_cluster_log_types with all five log types on aws_eks_cluster satisfies CKV_AWS_37.
An encryption_config block with provider.key_arn and resources = ["secrets"] is the correct fix for CKV_AWS_58.
Setting map_public_ip_on_launch = false on eks_subnet1 fixes the check.
Setting map_public_ip_on_launch = false on eks_subnet2 fixes the check.
An aws_flow_log resource with vpc_id referencing the VPC, traffic_type, and a log destination satisfies CKV2_AWS_11.
